about.heading: The Best Weed Dispensary In Lenox, Michigan
about.md: High Society Cannabis in Lenox stands out as a leading cannabis retailer, focused on delivering outstanding customer service and offering a diverse selection of premium cannabis products. Their collection features renowned brands like 710 Labs, Bloom, Camino, and Drip, celebrated for their quality and potency. This commitment to quality has solidified High Society Cannabis as a top choice for premium cannabis products in Lenox.

items.label: Order online for pickup; curbside customers get a text when the order is ready

items.title: Who Can Shop
items.md: Individuals 21 years or older can shop recreationally at our dispensary.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Present a government-issued ID or passport upon arrival and check in with our security and front desk team.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: Stay updated on special deals and discounts by providing your phone number and email address.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: A budtender will call you from the waiting area when it’s your turn. They’ll assist with product selection and address any questions, whether you’re a first-time visitor or a returning customer.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: After finalizing your choices, the budtender will notify our order preparation team. Payments are accepted via cash, credit, or debit cards.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: When your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process the payment, and review the items with you to ensure everything is correct before completing the purchase.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Explore our [Lenox dispensary menu](/shop/lenox/) online or reach out to us at [(586) 430-1347](tel:+15864301347) for any assistance.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Select your desired products, set quantities, add them to your cart, and choose a convenient pick-up time.

items.title: Check Out
items.md: Finalize your order by entering your details. New visitors will need to provide a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can log in for a quicker checkout.

items.title: Curbside Pickup
items.md: Prefer curbside pickup? Let us know, and we’ll send a text when your order is ready for collection.

items.title: Enjoy Responsibly
items.md: Use our cannabis products responsibly. We're here to provide a smooth and hassle-free shopping experience!

blocks.heading: What Our Customers Say About Us

items.q: What do I need to shop at High Society Cannabis Lenox?
items.a: To purchase from our dispensary, you must present a valid government-issued ID confirming you are 21 or older. Individuals 18 and older with a medical marijuana card are also eligible to shop.

items.q: How can I address a defective product?
items.a: If you encounter any issues with a product's quality or functionality, please contact us at [(586) 430-1347](tel:+15864301347) or visit the store where you made the purchase. Our team will be happy to assist.

items.q: What forms of payment are accepted?
items.a: Our dispensaries accept cash and debit payments, with an ATM accessible in-store. Some locations may offer additional payment options, so feel free to check ahead.

items.q: Is it legal to transport cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, but federal law prohibits transporting cannabis across state lines. Please refrain from taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What types of products does the dispensary offer?
items.a: We provide a wide range of high-quality cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Explore our menu or contact us for specific inquiries.

items.q: Does High Society provide benefits for loyal customers?
items.a: Yes, we do! High Society offers a loyalty program called The Society, allowing you to earn points on purchases and redeem them for discounts or special deals. Ask a staff member to get started.
